en: Colorized historic postcard showing the entrance gate of an industrial complex with a decorative archway reading "Sächs. Kupfer- und Messingwerke F. A. Lange." The gate is built of light stone with red-tiled roofs and coats of arms and plaques on both sides. Through the arch one sees a cobbled yard and picturesque half-timbered houses with red roofs and flower boxes. Large tree branches frame the top of the scene against a pastel sky.
